protocol: Frozen estimators; sequential historical features updated only after earlier results become available. Separate validation model selection, calibration and independent test.

A_logistic.calibration_method: regularized sigmoid on separate chronological calibration block

B_logistic.calibration_method: regularized sigmoid on separate chronological calibration block

C_logistic.calibration_method: regularized sigmoid on separate chronological calibration block

A_catboost.calibration_method: regularized sigmoid on separate chronological calibration block

B_catboost.calibration_method: regularized sigmoid on separate chronological calibration block

C_catboost.calibration_method: regularized sigmoid on separate chronological calibration block

C_catboost_uniform.calibration_method: regularized sigmoid on separate chronological calibration block

selection_rule: Minimum raw validation log loss across predeclared candidates. Test metrics never select models.

logistic.interpretation: Negative favors C; diagnostic interval, one temporal holdout and one training seed.

catboost.interpretation: Negative favors C; diagnostic interval, one temporal holdout and one training seed.

recency_comparison.note: The uniform-weight model is a predeclared selection candidate and recency sensitivity arm; deployment selected on validation only.

limitations: One chronological holdout and one training seed; no accuracy guarantee or causal BP effect.
Current downloadable snapshot cannot prove historical publication times; available_at is a conservative assumed outcome-availability boundary.
Name-based local pro IDs are stable within registry, but source lacks independent player IDs; unresolved real-person ambiguities remain.
C minus B bundles BP and patch; association is confounded by skill, opponent and draft selection.
Per-league and unseen-league cohorts assess transport descriptively, not a dedicated leave-region-out experiment.
Historical bans/first-pick values are used only as pregame metadata; timestamp availability of final BP is the caller's responsibility.
